freeze.text: A freeze is reported for {name}; applicability and any exception are unconfirmed. Ask the team to clarify.

history.text: Same-service incidents in this change category: {repeats}. Check whether their failure mechanisms apply to this change.

no_rollback.text: No rollback plan for a {tier}-tier service. The usual rollback is "{rollback}"; confirm it really undoes this change.

no_monitoring.text: No monitoring plan. Watch {watch} through every rollout stage.

config_drift.text: {name} config comes from {config_source}; diff staging and prod values before and after.

no_deploy_plan.text: No deploy plan, and {n_down} services sit downstream ({down}). Consider compatibility checks and a staged rollout plan.

degraded.text: Catalog reports degraded health: {degraded}. Verify current health and how existing symptoms could affect change monitoring.

dependencies.text: Downstream services that feel a failure here: {down}.
